# Bid the slabs, the cutouts, and the waterfalls.

> Price a quartz or granite countertop job from slabs, sink and cooktop cutouts, edge profile, backsplash, and waterfalls — not a published price per finished square foot. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper kitchen quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
